import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    cells=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==5]
    unseen=set(cells)
    comps=[]
    while unseen:
        start=unseen.pop(); comp={start}; stack=[start]
        while stack:
            r,c=stack.pop()
            for q in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                if q in unseen: unseen.remove(q); comp.add(q); stack.append(q)
        comps.append(comp)
    for comp in comps:
        rs=[r for r,c in comp]; cs=[c for r,c in comp]
        top,bottom,left,right=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        # Fill the interior of the outlined figure.
        for r in range(top+1,bottom):
            for c in range(left+1,right):
                if g[r][c]==0: g[r][c]=2
        # The opening in the top edge emits a leftward beam on the row above.
        holes=[c for c in range(left,right+1) if (top,c) not in comp]
        if holes and top>0:
            c=holes[0]
            for x in range(c+1): g[top-1][x]=2
    return g
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
